purpose.text: The ONNX Model Zoo's int8 MNIST network as one LexLean model: its parameters are content-addressed artifacts, its network is a language-1.2 graph, its boundary is a contract with validators and evidence, and its product is a certified Rust package bundle that replays offline. purpose.source:
The ONNX Model Zoo's int8 MNIST network as one LexLean model: its parameters

LexLean compiler, and nothing in this repository implements the model in any
other language (R1).

purpose.source:
dataflow-policy checks a Prism dataflow project script against its declared memory
and PII-encryption policies, and emits the project's canonical form. It is a
Prism application: its behavior is authored once in LexLean (`src/*.lex.tex`)
and PrismPM generates the verified browser application (GitHub Pages) and the
command-line interface from that single model. No application behavior is
written by hand outside the model.
purpose.title: dataflow-policy

purpose.text: PrismPM compiles authoritative Prism models into verified software artifacts. A model is a closed .lex.tex source graph: LexLean produces its semantic snapshot and Lean, Lean checks the proofs, lean4-prod exports only named verified roots, and generic generators produce Cargo, Core-Wasm, View, browser, and Hologram artifacts. Prism application behavior is never supplied by handwritten Lean or target-specific application code.
purpose.source:
PrismPM compiles authoritative Prism models into verified software artifacts. A
model is a closed `.lex.tex` source graph: LexLean produces its semantic
snapshot and Lean, Lean checks the proofs, `lean4-prod` exports only named
verified roots, and generic generators produce Cargo, Core-Wasm, View, browser,
and Hologram artifacts. Prism application behavior is never supplied by
handwritten Lean or target-specific application code.
purpose.title: PrismPM
